slot.brief: Statement-based question on Huygens' principle: construction of wavefronts and what each point on a wavefront represents.

stem: A plane wavefront in water advances during a short time interval. In Huygens' construction, each point on the original wavefront is regarded as
options: a point that sends out a secondary wavelet, with the backward envelope giving the advanced wavefront.
a point that sends out a secondary wavelet, with the forward envelope giving the advanced wavefront.
a point through which a ray travels, with the rays themselves forming the advanced wavefront.
a point that sends out a wavelet only along the direction of propagation.

verdicts.working: Each point on the original wavefront emits a secondary wavelet; their forward envelope forms the advanced wavefront.

working:
Each point of a wavefront acts as a source of secondary wavelets.
The forward envelope of these wavelets after the interval is the new wavefront.

Independent check: Each point on the original wavefront emits a secondary wavelet; their forward envelope forms the advanced wavefront.
solution: Each point on a wavefront acts as a source of secondary wavelets. After a short interval, the forward envelope of these wavelets forms the advanced wavefront.
